title: AvailabilityResponse
description: The set of available reservation time slots for a date and party size.

restaurantId.description: The restaurant the availability applies to.

date.description: The date the availability applies to.

partySize.description: The party size the availability applies to.

time.description: The available reservation date and time, in RFC 3339 format.

available.description: Whether the slot is available for booking.
